body: Orchestrator integration note (acceptance round): `npm run build` failed on the combined sprint work. `StartRunDialog.tsx` imported `epicBranch` from `src/core/schemas.ts`, which imports `src/core/ids.ts` (`node:crypto`), so the renderer bundle could not resolve `randomBytes`. Typecheck and vitest passed because they run under Node. The orchestrator moved the branch-name rule into the browser-safe `src/shared/domain/branchName.ts` (`epicBranchName`), used by both `schemas.ts` and the dialog, in sprint commit 7a3c80f. The advertised JSON schemas are unchanged (src/mcp fingerprint tests pass); build, typecheck, oxlint and the dialog tests pass.
